_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment; ADR-031 declarative fields, the VIES call stays imperative in ViesService (external register)
_meta.description: A supplier (Payee) carries the outcome of its last VIES check like a customer does, and a supplier invoice carries the seller's VAT number from the UBL invoice with the outcome of the check made when it arrived.

vatIdValidationStatus.title: VAT number check
vatIdValidationStatus.description: The outcome of the last check of the VAT number against the EU VIES register: unchecked, valid, invalid, or vies_outage when VIES could not be reached.

vatIdValidatedAt.title: VAT number last valid on
vatIdValidatedAt.description: When VIES last confirmed the VAT number as valid.

vatIdValidUntil.title: VAT number check valid until
vatIdValidUntil.description: Until when the last valid check is reused without asking VIES again.

sellerVatId.title: Seller VAT number
sellerVatId.description: The seller's VAT number as the invoice states it, read from a UBL invoice or typed in.

sellerVatIdValidationStatus.title: Seller VAT number check
sellerVatIdValidationStatus.description: The outcome of the VIES check made when an invoice from another EU country arrived: unchecked, valid, invalid, or vies_outage when VIES could not be reached.

sellerVatIdValidatedAt.title: Seller VAT number last valid on
sellerVatIdValidatedAt.description: When VIES last confirmed the seller's VAT number as valid.
